host.appliesTo: the nine golden application sources (hosts, executions, ports, bindings, definition, host IO)
host.description: The family face is akka typed + CQRS by declaration. The sanctioned mutation face is exactly the R2(b) in-memory waiter coalescing: local var/assignment inside the behavior setup blocks of the three hosts — a var FIELD, a nonlocal return, reflection, timers, randomness, stdout and mutable collections stay banned by the engine. throw is the sanctioned fail-closed value-domain refusal (codec slots, unrepresentable observations, stage errors); try is admitted only for the effect hosts' callback-boundary seam; both are pinned site-by-site by structural properties, not by the engine. The engine admits Term.NewAnonymous (the anonymous port-implementation face of the definition). java import statements stay banned; fully-qualified java references are the sanctioned zero-import form. The Array type is admitted solely as Array[Byte] (the byte-digest and akka wire faces); structural properties pin that no other array form appears, and AnyRef is admitted in the serializer layer only (the fixed akka SerializerWithStringManifest signature).
host.note: Maxima are judged frozen bounds on the hand-balanced golden shapes (the host maximum grew 44 to 45 when the R3 no-answer-never-wipes-evidence guard landed; the revision is recorded here at freeze time) (event-sourced command handlers are legitimately large but bounded); a scope that outgrows them is a shape-rewrite signal, never a bound bump.

serializer.appliesToDelta: same banned set as host, plus Term.Try stays banned — the serializer is a total function; its wire refusals are throws

support.description: No forbidden structural checks; 5/2 default maxima with exact closed-dispatch exceptions in scope-exceptions.tsv. The fixture constructs a local typed ActorSystem with the persistence-testkit journal (serialize=false: the journal assertions look at event facts, while the serializers prove the wire independently).
support.exceptions: Exact file/owner/kind with finite maxima and justification. No whole-file exemption or project average.

reject: var fields and any assignment outside the R2(b) coalescing blocks
implicit time/randomness beyond the judged R1 deadline slots
stdout/printStackTrace in place of structured logging
allow: sealed ADTs over every dispatch face (T1): result kinds, observation statuses, reconcile decisions
fail-closed require/throw for illegal value domains, and the akka-serializer wire-refusal throw
local var/assignment only inside the R2(b) in-memory waiter coalescing blocks
obligation-table-driven port wiring with per-role binding records (no Option/null faces)
constructor-injected ports and explicit composition (install or refuse)
plainFpOo.qualification: Syntactic checks do not alone prove semantic purity or OO responsibility. Exact behavior properties are also reviewed (real coordinator rounds, persistence-testkit journal, probe technical ports).
